intro.say: Food gives us energy to run, play and grow. Let's meet the food groups!

rounds.say: Fruits are sweet foods that grow on plants, like apples and bananas. Vegetables are plants we eat, like carrots and broccoli.
rounds.caption: fruits · vegetables

rounds.say: Grains like bread and rice give us energy. Protein like eggs and fish helps us grow. Dairy like milk and cheese helps our bones.
rounds.caption: grains · protein · dairy

options.label: carrot
options.why: A carrot is a vegetable. A banana is a fruit.

options.label: bread
options.why: Bread is a grain. A banana is a fruit.

rounds.explain: A banana is a sweet fruit.

options.label: cheese
options.why: Cheese is made from milk. Broccoli is a vegetable.

rounds.ask: Is it a fruit or a vegetable?
rounds.explain: Bananas, grapes and strawberries are fruits. Carrots, lettuce and cucumbers are vegetables.

rounds.ask: Which drink is made by cows and is dairy?

options.label: water
options.why: Water is great, but milk is the dairy drink.

options.label: orange juice
options.why: Juice comes from fruit. Milk is dairy.

rounds.explain: Milk comes from cows, and it is a dairy food.

intro.say: Some foods are everyday foods that help us grow. Others are sometimes foods, treats for now and then.

rounds.say: Everyday foods like fruit, vegetables, bread, eggs and milk help our bodies grow strong.
rounds.caption: everyday foods

rounds.say: Sometimes foods like cake, candy and fries are yummy treats. We enjoy them now and then, not every day.
rounds.caption: sometimes foods

rounds.ask: Is it an everyday food or a sometimes food?
rounds.explain: Fruit, vegetables and eggs are everyday foods. Donuts, lollipops and fries are treats.

rounds.ask: Which is the best drink when you are thirsty?

options.label: soda
options.why: Soda has lots of sugar. Water is best for thirst.

options.label: milkshake
options.why: Milkshakes are a treat. Water is best for thirst.

rounds.explain: Water is the best drink. Our bodies need lots of it every day.

rounds.ask: Which one is a sometimes food?

options.label: apple
options.why: Apples are everyday foods.

options.label: rice
options.why: Rice is an everyday food that gives us energy.

rounds.explain: Cake is a yummy treat for special times, like birthdays.

rounds.ask: Which snack is an everyday food?

options.label: candy
options.why: Candy is a sometimes treat.

rounds.explain: Strawberries are fruit, and fruit is an everyday food.

intro.say: Let's sort foods into their groups: fruit, vegetables, grains, protein and dairy.

rounds.say: Grains come from plants like wheat and rice. Bread, pasta, rice and cereal are all grains.
rounds.caption: grains

rounds.say: Protein foods include meat, fish, eggs and nuts. Dairy foods are made from milk, like cheese and yogurt.
rounds.caption: protein · dairy

rounds.ask: Fruit, vegetable, or grain? Sort them!
rounds.explain: Pears and watermelon are fruits, carrots and corn are vegetables, and pasta and rice are grains.
Eggs, fish and nuts are protein. Cheese, milk and ice cream are made from milk, so they are dairy.

rounds.ask: Which food group is cheese in?

options.label: grains
options.why: Grains are things like bread. Cheese is made from milk.

options.label: protein
options.why: Cheese has some protein, but it is made from milk, so it's dairy.

rounds.explain: Cheese is made from milk, so it is dairy.

options.label: egg
options.why: An egg is a protein food.

options.label: pear
options.why: A pear is a fruit.

rounds.explain: Bread is made from wheat, which is a grain.

rounds.ask: Which food group gives us lots of energy to run and play?

options.label: water
options.why: Water keeps us healthy, but grains give lots of energy.

rounds.explain: Grains like pasta, rice and bread give us energy.

intro.say: Different foods help our bodies in different ways. Let's find out why, and build a balanced plate!

rounds.say: Dairy foods like milk have calcium. Calcium helps build strong bones and teeth.
rounds.caption: dairy → strong bones

rounds.say: Protein helps build strong muscles. Fruit and vegetables have vitamins that keep us healthy. Carrots help keep our eyes healthy.
rounds.caption: protein → muscles · vitamins → healthy

rounds.say: A balanced plate has fruit and vegetables on half, plus some grains, some protein, and a dairy drink.
rounds.caption: a balanced plate

rounds.ask: Why is milk good for you?

options.label: it makes you taller than a tree
options.why: Milk won't make you that tall! It helps build strong bones.

options.label: it gives you no energy
options.why: Milk does give energy. It's best known for strong bones.

rounds.explain: Milk has calcium, which helps build strong bones and teeth.

rounds.ask: Which food helps build strong muscles?

options.label: lollipop
options.why: Lollipops are sweet treats. Protein helps build muscles.

options.label: lettuce
options.why: Lettuce has vitamins, but protein like eggs builds muscles.

rounds.explain: Eggs have protein, and protein helps build strong muscles.

rounds.ask: Which plate is the most balanced?

options.why: That plate is all treats. A balanced plate has many food groups.
That plate is all grains. Add vegetables, protein and dairy.

rounds.explain: That plate has vegetables, grains, protein and dairy. That's balanced!
rounds.hint: Look for the plate with the most different food groups.

rounds.ask: What does it help? Sort each food by its job.
rounds.explain: Dairy builds bones, protein builds muscles, and grains give us energy.

rounds.ask: Why do we need to drink water every day?

options.label: water tastes like candy
options.why: Water has no sugar. We drink it because our bodies need it.

options.label: to make us sleepy
options.why: Water doesn't make us sleepy. Our bodies need it to work well.

rounds.explain: Our bodies are mostly water, so we need to drink it to stay healthy.
